# John J. Lembo

> John J. Lembo is an author, consultant, educator, mentor and speaker with nearly four decades in the built environment. He is the author of *So You Want to Be a Consultant* and Managing Principal of The Navitas Group, a strategic facilities management consulting firm founded in 2006. He writes The Solution Navigator on Substack.

John helps people understand the terrain, sort through the noise, and find a practical path forward. His style is practical, direct, and grounded in experience. He has worked as an employee, executive, consultant, educator, mentor, and independent advisor, helping organizations ranging from startups and nonprofits to Fortune 500 companies make sense of complex operational and strategic challenges.

## The book

- [So You Want to Be a Consultant](https://web-ptg.github.io/jjlembo/#book): A clear-eyed, experience-driven guide to what consulting really is, beyond the title, the hype, or the misconceptions. Subtitle: Hard Truths, Real Tools and the no-BS Road to Consulting Success
- [Ten more tips](https://john-lembo.kit.com/512f669cc6): Ten more tips and strategies for becoming a consultant that aren't in the book

## The Navitas Group

- [TheNavitasGroup.com](http://www.TheNavitasGroup.com): Strategic facilities management consulting serving healthcare, hospitality, commercial real estate, multi-building campuses, and institutional environments. The firm represents the owner's interest and does not sell equipment or represent manufacturers.
